presets.description: White capitals with a thick black outline and a hard shadow, for punchy hooks.

color.description: Its colour; its alpha sets the strength (white when omitted).

radius.description: How far it reaches in em, from 0 to 2 (0.3 when omitted).

Shadow.description: A shadow cast by the letters (and their outline).

blur.description: How soft it is in em, from 0 (sharp) to 1 (0.08 when omitted).

offset.description:
How far it falls, right and down, in em, each from -1 to 1 ([0.06, 0.06] when
omitted).

width.description: Its width as a fraction of the font size (0.12 when omitted).

TextBox.description: A box behind each line of text, for captions and text clips.

padding.description: Space around the text as a fraction of the font size (0.25 when omitted).

radius.description: Corner radius as a fraction of the box height (0.3 when omitted).

oneOf.description: The First Letter Of Every Word In Capitals, the rest lower case.

style_schema.description:
Text appearance. Lengths such as spacing, stroke and shadow are fractions of the font
size (em), so a style looks the same at every size.

box.description: Box behind each line (off when omitted).

case.description: Letter case shown; the text itself is kept as written.

font.description:
Font family: `Inter` (bundled) or a family of one of the project's font assets;
`Inter` when omitted.

glow.description: Soft light around the letters (off when omitted).

letter_spacing.description: Extra space between letters in em, from -0.5 to 2; 0 when omitted.

line_height.description:
Distance between lines as a multiple of the font size, from 0.5 to 4; 1.2 when
omitted.

shadow.description: Shadow under the letters (off when omitted).

size.description: Font size as a fraction of the canvas height.

stroke.description: Outline around the letters (off when omitted).

style_schema.title: TextStyle

templates.description: A name and a role at the lower left, each on a dark box, appearing word by word.

templates.description: A spaced kicker such as a chapter number over a large title, fading in line by line.
templates.name: chapter

templates.description: A quotation typed out letter by letter, with its author under it.
templates.name: quote

templates.description: A short note on a yellow marker box at the upper left, popping in word by word.

templates.description: A closing message with a call to action under it, fading in line by line.
templates.name: end-card

time_input_schema.description: A time with an explicit unit. Frame and timecode values use the timeline frame rate. Bare numbers are rejected.

timecode.description: HH:MM:SS:FF, or HH:MM:SS;FF for drop-frame
